g.title: Medium shot. A room at night. Bob, centre, arms crossed. Caller, off panel, shouting: Open up! Bob: Who is it? Neighbour, off panel: Keep it down in there.

Close-up. A room at night. Bob, centre, arms crossed. Upstairs, off panel: Is everything all right? Bob, quietly: Fine. Go back to sleep. Caller, off panel: Then open the door. Caller, off panel: I know you're there.
